Frequency once per day

Trigger An effect would have you act against your own interest because of a donor thread, or the GM would have your donor surface at Loud Resonance.

You shove the passenger back down. Negate the triggering effect entirely — the donor doesn't get their moment this time. This doesn't lower the Resonance that caused it, only this one occurrence.
